display_name: Services — Two-Wheeler / Auto Repair & Servicing Workshop
overview: Two-wheeler, three-wheeler, or car repair, mechanical servicing, engine overhaul, puncture/tyre works, and spare parts resale. Revenue is driven by service labor charges plus spare parts markup. High technician skill dependency and repeat neighborhood footfall.
red_flags_json: Single-mechanic dependency with no secondary skilled staff or apprentice
Operating on roadside or unauthorized encroachment risking municipal displacement
Mounting unpaid customer credit for major vehicle engine overhauls
Frequent customer disputes regarding faulty repairs or delayed deliveries
